name: Ocean Overhaul
description: Adds 36 ocean-themed blocks (decorative prismarine, pearl, and sea glass sets, a full driftwood wood set, and the deep-ocean Abyssal Trench's glowing plankton, abyssal vents, and giant clams), the Tidal tool + armor sets, a deep-sea diving kit (Deep-Sea Helmet, Oxygen Tank, Flippers), the loyalty-throw Harpoon, a stockable Aquarium, Reef Fish + Jellyfish buckets, ocean foods, Megalodon Tooth + Abyssal Fang drops, and four naturally-spawning sea creatures (the Megalodon boss, the hostile Abyssal Lurker, Reef Fish, and Jellyfish), plus a dedicated Ocean Overhaul creative tab.
